paragraph: The Granville composite delivers a constructive primary verdict of 69/100 with no breadth divergence warning in effect, signaling sound mechanical health across index internals. This bullish bias is driven by authentic broad-market participation rather than narrow mega-cap leadership, anchored by equal-weight outperformance (RSP/SPY +0.68%) and classic transport confirmation (IYT/SPY +0.49%), even as credit confidence (HYG/LQD -0.24%) and semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +0.14%) hover in neutral territory. The macro backdrop fully accommodates this advance, with the VIX quiescent at 17.43 within a steep contango structure, high-yield spreads anchored at 3.29%, and a falling 10-year real yield at 2.74% easing equity discount rates. Additional support from small-cap outperformance (0.3584) and stable inflation expectations (5Y5Y forward at 2.32%) reinforces an environment clear of immediate structural distribution. Lean long into the session with expectations for steady, broad-based upside continuation.
